integrity: Two independently organized exhaustive enumeration and vertex-orbit comparison programs have executable source and outputs embedded. Both share the external graph-atlas and planarity implementation, so verification is not independent certification.
limitations: Finite order at most eight, connected simple outerplanar graphs and uniform initial vertex colour only. Does not assert distinguishing power between distinct graphs, nor an all-order theorem. Specialized priority risk remains.
title: The first biconnected outerplanar counting-refinement obstructions
